newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-PROMOTED BOLTON SIGN COX FROM RELEGATED BORO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PROMOTED BOLTON SIGN COX FROM RELEGATED BORO.

text.p: Newly promoted English premier league club Bolton Wanderers signed defender Neil Cox from relegated Middlesbrough on Wednesday for a reported fee of 1.5 million pounds ($2.5 million).

Cox, 25, who was Bryan Robson's first major signing three years ago, was previously at Aston Villa and had been a target of Bolton boss Colin Todd ever since he refused to sign a new contract at Middlesbrough.

Todd said: "Neil is a very versatile player who can play in the back four and in midfield. He has a lot of experience for a player of his age and although he only has been capped at under-21 level, I would expect him to get a full cap before too long."
Todd said he would probably play Cox on the right side of defence.
